literary_titans.author: Dante Alighieri
literary_titans.significance: The architectural summit of Western vernacular literature; hendecasyllabic tercets forming an interlocking chain of triple rhymes embodying theological teleology and geometric symmetry.
literary_titans.scholarly_edition: Ed. Giorgio Petrocchi (Mondadori Critical Edition); Trans. & Commentary Robert and Jean Hollander (Anchor / Princeton University Press, 3 vols.).

literary_titans.author: Homer
literary_titans.significance: Foundational Western epic; formulaic epithets, ring-composition, and heroic aristeia governing cosmic tragedy and human nostos.
literary_titans.scholarly_edition: Oxford Classical Texts (ed. D.B. Monro & T.W. Allen); Trans. Richmond Lattimore (Univ. of Chicago Press) / Trans. Emily Wilson (W.W. Norton).

literary_titans.author: John Milton
literary_titans.significance: Latinate grammatical inversion, enjambed cosmic architecture, and theological theodicy re-engineering classical epic conventions into English.
literary_titans.scholarly_edition: Ed. Alastair Fowler (Longman Annotated English Poets, Routledge) / Ed. John Carey (Oxford English Texts).

literary_titans.author: William Shakespeare
literary_titans.significance: The pinnacle of English lyric scansion; phonetic chiasmus, dialectical voltas, and temporal anxiety exploring love, art, and mortality.
literary_titans.scholarly_edition: The Arden Shakespeare (ed. Katherine Duncan-Jones) / Helen Vendler, The Art of Shakespeare's Sonnets (Harvard University Press).

literary_titans.author: Sin-leqi-unninni (Recension)
literary_titans.significance: The oldest surviving monumental literary masterpiece; cuneiform parallelismus membrorum exploring existential dread, immortality, and civilization.
literary_titans.scholarly_edition: Andrew George, The Babylonian Gilgamesh Epic: Critical Edition and Cuneiform Texts (2 vols., Oxford University Press, 2003).

literary_titans.author: Maharshi Krishna Dvaipayana Vyasa
literary_titans.significance: The longest epic poem in world literature; 100,000 shlokas articulating cosmic dharma, karma, non-attachment, and ontological selfhood.
literary_titans.scholarly_edition: Bhandarkar Oriental Research Institute (BORI Critical Edition); Trans. J.A.B. van Buitenen (Univ. of Chicago Press); Bhagavad Gita ed. Winthrop Sargeant (SUNY Press).

literary_titans.author: Du Fu (Tu Fu)
literary_titans.significance: Maximum syntactic and tonal compression in human literature; ping/ze tonal antithesis across symmetrical middle couplets.
literary_titans.scholarly_edition: Stephen Owen, The Poetry of Du Fu (6 vols., De Gruyter / Library of Chinese Humanities, 2015); David Hawkes, A Little Primer of Tu Fu (Oxford / Renditions).

literary_titans.author: Li Bai (Li Po)
literary_titans.work: The Collected Songs and Ancient Verses (Gushi & Yuefu)
literary_titans.significance: Daoist celestial freedom and intoxicating metrical elasticity; dynamic breaking of conventional metric constraints in favor of cosmic spontaneity.
literary_titans.scholarly_edition: Haun Saussy & Burton Watson, Selected Poems of Li Po (Columbia University Press); Stephen Owen, The Great Age of Chinese Poetry (Yale UP).

literary_titans.author: Jalal al-Din Muhammad Rumi
literary_titans.significance: The Quran in the Persian tongue; ecstatic allegorical journey dissolving the illusion of the ego into divine oceanic unity.
literary_titans.scholarly_edition: Reynold A. Nicholson, The Mathnawí of Jalálu'ddín Rúmí (8 vols., E.J.W. Gibb Memorial Trust / Cambridge University Press); Franklin D. Lewis, Rumi: Past and Present, East and West (Oneworld).

literary_titans.author: Hafez Shirazi
literary_titans.significance: The highest pinnacle of Persian lyricism; intentional hermeneutic ambiguity (rind), weaving erotic and mystical registers into iridescent wordplay.
literary_titans.scholarly_edition: Parviz Natel-Khanlari (Tehran Critical Edition); Trans. Dick Davis, Faces of Love: Hafez and the Poets of Shiraz (Penguin Classics); Trans. Peter Avery, The Collected Lyrics of Hafiz of Shiraz (Archetype).

literary_titans.author: Publius Vergilius Maro (Virgil)
literary_titans.significance: The definitive masterpiece of Golden Age Latin metrics; caesura control, metrical counterpoint, and solemn tragic depth.
literary_titans.scholarly_edition: Oxford Classical Texts (ed. R.A.B. Mynors); Loeb Classical Library Vol. 63–64 (Harvard UP); Trans. Robert Fagles (Penguin) / Sarah Ruden (Yale UP).

literary_titans.author: Publius Ovidius Naso (Ovid)
literary_titans.significance: Fluid narrative hexameter enacting perpetual physical and ontological transformation; the encyclopedia of classical myth and psychological mutability.
literary_titans.scholarly_edition: Oxford Classical Texts (ed. R.J. Tarrant); Loeb Classical Library Vol. 42–43 (Harvard UP); Trans. Allen Mandelbaum (Harcourt).

literary_titans.author: John Keats
literary_titans.significance: Unsurpassed sensory synesthesia, negative capability, and harmonic assonance exploring art, temporality, and grief.
literary_titans.scholarly_edition: Jack Stillinger, The Poems of John Keats (Harvard University Press / Belknap); Miriam Allott, The Poems of John Keats (Longman).

literary_titans.author: Percy Bysshe Shelley
literary_titans.work: Prometheus Unbound & Ode to the West Wind
literary_titans.form: Terza Rima Lyrical Propulsion & Poly-metric Drama
literary_titans.significance: Philosophical idealism, linguistic velocity, and revolutionary Platonism transforming poetic metre into an atmospheric force of liberation.
literary_titans.scholarly_edition: Donald H. Reiman & Sharon B. Powers, Shelley's Poetry and Prose (Norton Critical Editions); Oxford English Texts (ed. Neville Rogers).

literary_titans.author: Walt Whitman
literary_titans.significance: Acoustic catalogues, expansive biblical parallelism, and radical democratic pantheism establishing American modernist prosody.
literary_titans.scholarly_edition: Sculley Bradley & Harold W. Blodgett, Leaves of Grass: Norton Critical Edition; Justin Kaplan, Walt Whitman: Complete Poetry and Collected Prose (Library of America).

literary_titans.author: Emily Dickinson
literary_titans.work: The Poems of Emily Dickinson (1,789 Poems)
literary_titans.form: Common Hymn Meter & Ballad Measure with Dash & Slant Rhyme
literary_titans.significance: Radical compression, metaphysical slant rhymes, and syntactic fracture converting standard hymnal meter into existential lightning.
literary_titans.scholarly_edition: R.W. Franklin, The Poems of Emily Dickinson: Variorum Edition (3 vols., Harvard University Press / Belknap); Thomas H. Johnson, The Complete Poems.

literary_titans.author: Charles Baudelaire
literary_titans.significance: The foundation of European Modernism; the tension between Spleen (ennui) and Idéal (spiritual transcendent form) through crystalline classical alexandrines.
literary_titans.scholarly_edition: Claude Pichois, Baudelaire: Œuvres complètes (Bibliothèque de la Pléiade, Gallimard); Trans. Richard Howard (David R. Godine, American Book Award).

literary_titans.author: Arthur Rimbaud
literary_titans.significance: Systematic derangement of all senses; alchemy of the verb breaking syntax open to capture hallucinated modern realities.
literary_titans.scholarly_edition: André Guyaux, Rimbaud: Œuvres complètes (Bibliothèque de la Pléiade, Gallimard); Trans. Wyatt Mason (Modern Library) / Trans. Louise Varèse (New Directions).

literary_titans.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
literary_titans.significance: The encyclopedic culmination of European Romanticism and Classicism; constant striving (Streben) enacted through shifting poetic meters.
literary_titans.scholarly_edition: Albrecht Schöne, Goethe: Faust (Deutscher Klassiker Verlag); Trans. Walter Kaufmann (Anchor Books / Princeton UP); Trans. Stuart Atkins (Princeton).

literary_titans.author: Friedrich Hölderlin
literary_titans.form: Pindaric Triadic Free Rhythms & Elegiac Distichs
literary_titans.significance: Philosophical lyricism at the limit of language; paratactic divine presence and absence mourning the departure of the sacred.
literary_titans.scholarly_edition: D.E. Sattler, Hölderlin: Sämtliche Werke (Frankfurter Ausgabe); Michael Hamburger, Friedrich Hölderlin: Selected Poems and Fragments (Penguin Classics / Anvil).

literary_titans.author: Stéphane Mallarmé
literary_titans.work: Poésies & Un Coup de Dés Jamais N'Abolira Le Hasard
literary_titans.significance: A constellation of typographical score-playing across the double-page spread; language confronting absolute contingency and the abyss of the blank page.
literary_titans.scholarly_edition: Bertrand Marchal, Mallarmé: Œuvres complètes (2 vols., Bibliothèque de la Pléiade, Gallimard); E.H. & A.M. Blackmore, Collected Poems (Oxford World's Classics).

literary_titans.author: Titus Lucretius Carus
literary_titans.work: De Rerum Natura (On the Nature of Things)
literary_titans.significance: Atomistic physics, Epicurean materialist cosmology, and the clinamen (atomic swerve); proving mortality and liberating humanity from superstition through hexameter.
literary_titans.scholarly_edition: Oxford Classical Texts (ed. Cyril Bailey, 3 vols.); Loeb Classical Library Vol. 181 (Harvard UP, ed. W.H.D. Rouse & M.F. Smith); Trans. A.E. Stallings (Penguin).

linguistics_prosody.title: The Rhythms of English Poetry
linguistics_prosody.author: Derek Attridge
linguistics_prosody.focus: Beat-offbeat prosodic rule; stress-timing; generative phonological realization of metrical templates.

linguistics_prosody.title: Linguistics and Poetics
linguistics_prosody.author: Roman Jakobson
linguistics_prosody.publisher: Style in Language, ed. Thomas A. Sebeok, MIT Press
linguistics_prosody.focus: The six constitutive factors of verbal communication; projection of the principle of equivalence from the axis of selection into the axis of combination.

linguistics_prosody.title: The Role of Linguistics in the Study of Metrics
linguistics_prosody.author: Paul Kiparsky
linguistics_prosody.publisher: Formal Syntax / Linguistic Inquiry, MIT Press
linguistics_prosody.focus: Generative metrics; tree structures of rhythmic alternation; bracket erasure in prosodic phrasing.

linguistics_prosody.title: Metaphors We Live By
linguistics_prosody.author: George Lakoff & Mark Johnson
linguistics_prosody.focus: Conceptual metaphor theory; cognitive mapping from concrete bodily source domains to abstract target domains.

linguistics_prosody.title: The Philosophy of Rhetoric
linguistics_prosody.author: I.A. Richards
linguistics_prosody.focus: Tenor and Vehicle interaction theory; contextual definition of verbal signification; New Critical semantics.

linguistics_prosody.title: Anatomy of Criticism: Four Essays
linguistics_prosody.author: Northrop Frye
linguistics_prosody.focus: Archetypal mythoi (comedy, romance, tragedy, satire); structural taxonomy of Western imaginative modes.

linguistics_prosody.title: The Verbal Icon: Studies in the Meaning of Poetry
linguistics_prosody.author: W.K. Wimsatt & Monroe Beardsley
linguistics_prosody.focus: The Intentional Fallacy and Affective Fallacy; autotelic verbal structure; objective correlative.

musicology_psychoacoustics.title: On the Sensations of Tone as a Physiological Basis for the Theory of Music
musicology_psychoacoustics.author: Hermann von Helmholtz
musicology_psychoacoustics.publisher: Dover Publications (orig. 1863; Eng. trans. Alexander J. Ellis 1885)
musicology_psychoacoustics.focus: Fourier acoustical analysis of timbre, sympathetic cochlear resonators, physiological roughness, harmonic overtone series.

musicology_psychoacoustics.title: Treatise on Harmony (Traité de l'harmonie)
musicology_psychoacoustics.author: Jean-Philippe Rameau
musicology_psychoacoustics.publisher: Dover Publications (orig. 1722; Eng. trans. Philip Gossett 1971)
musicology_psychoacoustics.focus: Fundamental bass (basse fondamentale); inversion equivalence; acoustic generation of triads.

musicology_psychoacoustics.title: Free Composition (Der freie Satz)
musicology_psychoacoustics.author: Heinrich Schenker
musicology_psychoacoustics.focus: Schenkerian structural hierarchy: Ursatz, Urlinie, bass arpeggiation, multi-level prolongation and voice-leading reductions.

musicology_psychoacoustics.title: A Generative Theory of Tonal Music (GTTM)
musicology_psychoacoustics.author: Fred Lerdahl & Ray Jackendoff
musicology_psychoacoustics.focus: Formal cognitive rule system: Grouping Preference Rules (GPR), Metrical Preference Rules (MPR), Time-Span Reduction, Prolongational Reduction.

musicology_psychoacoustics.title: An Introduction to the Psychology of Hearing
musicology_psychoacoustics.author: Brian C.J. Moore
musicology_psychoacoustics.focus: Auditory filter banks, Equivalent Rectangular Bandwidth (ERB), critical masking bands, psychoacoustic loudness integration curves.

musicology_psychoacoustics.title: ITU-R BS.1770-4: Algorithms to measure audio programme loudness and true-peak audio level
musicology_psychoacoustics.author: International Telecommunication Union
musicology_psychoacoustics.focus: Standard K-weighting curve filter equations, relative and absolute energy gating thresholds, integrated LUFS/LKFS algorithms.

aerodynamics_flight.title: Fundamentals of Aerodynamics
aerodynamics_flight.author: John D. Anderson, Jr.
aerodynamics_flight.focus: Incompressible and compressible Navier-Stokes, boundary layer separation, transonic shock-wave formations, Prandtl-Meyer expansion waves, wave drag divergence.

aerodynamics_flight.title: Applications of Modern Hydrodynamics to Aeronautics
aerodynamics_flight.author: Ludwig Prandtl
aerodynamics_flight.focus: Boundary layer formulation (1904), lifting-line theory for 3D wings, induced drag minimization via elliptical lift distribution.

aerodynamics_flight.title: Elements of Propulsion: Gas Turbines and Rockets
aerodynamics_flight.author: Jack D. Mattingly & Keith M. Boyer
aerodynamics_flight.focus: Brayton cycle thermodynamic efficiencies, ultra-high bypass ratio turbofans, blade cooling thermodynamics, specific impulse optimization.

aerodynamics_flight.title: Aircraft Control and Simulation: Dynamics, Controls Design, and Autonomous Systems
aerodynamics_flight.author: Brian L. Stevens, Frank L. Lewis, & Eric N. Johnson
aerodynamics_flight.focus: 6-DOF non-linear equations of motion, aerodynamic stability and control derivatives, Fly-By-Wire control law feedback matrices.

aerodynamics_flight.title: Title 14 CFR Part 25: Airworthiness Standards for Transport Category Airplanes
aerodynamics_flight.author: Federal Aviation Administration (FAA)
aerodynamics_flight.focus: Structural flight envelope limits, gust loads (V_g), aeroelastic flutter margin certification, ETOPS 330-min diversion criteria.

vehicle_dynamics_engineering.title: Fundamentals of Vehicle Dynamics
vehicle_dynamics_engineering.author: Thomas D. Gillespie
vehicle_dynamics_engineering.focus: Longitudinal and lateral load transfer, suspension roll centers, anti-dive and anti-squat geometry, understeer gradient, yaw velocity response.

vehicle_dynamics_engineering.title: Tire and Vehicle Dynamics
vehicle_dynamics_engineering.author: Hans B. Pacejka
vehicle_dynamics_engineering.focus: Pacejka Magic Formula non-linear tire model, relaxation length, combined cornering and braking slip friction ellipse, contact patch kinematics.

vehicle_dynamics_engineering.title: Internal Combustion Engine Fundamentals
vehicle_dynamics_engineering.author: John B. Heywood
vehicle_dynamics_engineering.focus: Otto and Diesel air cycles, quad-turbocharged volumetric efficiency, cylinder in-flow turbulence, thermal efficiency and heat rejection.

vehicle_dynamics_engineering.title: Modern Electric, Hybrid Electric, and Fuel Cell Vehicles
vehicle_dynamics_engineering.author: Mehrdad Ehsani, Yimin Gao, Stefano Longo, & Kambiz Ebrahimi
vehicle_dynamics_engineering.focus: Axial-flux permanent magnet synchronous motors, silicon carbide (SiC) inverters, dual/tri-motor torque vectoring, high-voltage battery thermodynamic management.
